Name: Yandere Elliott Portraits. (Canvas Edition.)
Author: CanvasCutter
Description:
[i]"Dream a sweet dream for me, my dear."[/i]

This is my personally made portrait set for the Yandere Elliott! Inspired by [b]NinTheCactus69's[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14270]portrait mod[/url], I've made my own personal set of portraits. Of course, there's many different sets to choose from, but this one's [i]fancy.[/i]

There is a set of old files still available to download as [b]optional files[/b],[b] [/b]using Poltergeister's seasonal cute outfit's, but the new file has it's own style!

[b][u][size=3]INSTALLATION PROCESS:

[/size][/u]1. Be sure you have SMAPI and CONTENT PATCHER installed.
    If using the "Seasonal Outfits" mod, disable Elliott in the config menu. It will not work otherwise.
3. Put the unzipped folder inside of your Mods folder!

[/b]And that should be it!
